violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw pork was observed being stored above tomato soup in the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW PORK TO THE RAW MEAT SHELF.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed dishes being washed in the Memory Care chemical dish machine. Upon testing with chlorine test strips, rinse cycle was observed under 50ppm of chlorine concentration
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO BRING ALL DISHES TO THE LARGE, HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE. PIC CALLED SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR DISH MACHINE

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR mobile Hot Box, mashed potatoes was observed at 133f; 2) in the 1DR glass Hot Box, mashed potatoes was observed at 134f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED THE MASHED POTATOES IN THE STEAMER. MASHED POTATOES WAS LATER OBSERVED AT 173f.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Memory Care chemical dish machine
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. REPAIR THIS DISH MACHINE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: In the 1st floor servery, a hand washing sign was not observed posted at the hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH A HAND WASHING SIGN.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: At the 1st floor servery, the interior of the microwave was observed with crusted food splatter.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO START CLEANING MICROWAVE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed staff member use the hand sink in the second floor servery as a dump sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBER TO ONLY USE THE HAND SINK FOR HAND WASHING. BEVERAGES WILL BE DUMPED AT THE GARBAGE DISPOSAL AREA.
